label: Vaccine
description: ATC J07, or 'vaccin' in category tags or drug name. Not testable on plain tissue samples.

label: Antibody
description: DrugBank type 'biotech' and drug name ending in 'mab'. Not testable on plain tissue samples.

label: OtherBiotech
description: type 'biotech' that is neither vaccine nor antibody (enzymes, hormones, immune globulins, cell products). 0 = no penalty until the team decides.

label: Diagnostic
description: Diagnostic or imaging agent: ATC V08/V09 (contrast media, radiopharmaceuticals) or a diagnostic category tag.

label: Immunosup
description: DrugBank category 'Immunosuppressive Agents' (broad: includes many cytotoxics and corticosteroids).

label: AntiInflam
description: ATC M01A or an anti-inflammatory category tag.

label: TopicalOnly
description: Every listed route is topical, cutaneous, ophthalmic, otic, dental or intravitreal (no systemic route). Nasal and transdermal are not counted as topical.

label: SafetyUnknown
description: No toxicity text and no toxicity-type category tag (also forced in code when the input has none).

label: Oral/Inh
description: At least one oral or inhalation route listed.
